method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review in adjacent verse context; printed edition source IDs; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional

corrections.en: His true courage rose to the full,
corrections.reason: Чын кайраты бүт толуп: his courage fills.

corrections.en: He glanced to either side,
corrections.reason: Эки жагын каранып: he looks to both sides.

corrections.en: Growing fierce with anger,
corrections.reason: Ачууланып is participial, not an imperative.

corrections.en: Licking his lips and nose,
corrections.reason: Эрди-мурдун includes lips and nose.

corrections.en: His courage boiling, his spirit surging,
corrections.reason: Кайрат кайнап, жан уруп describes courage and spirit in motion.

corrections.en: He summoned fierce resolve.
corrections.reason: Катуу кайрат баштады describes Sarybai taking up fierce resolve.

corrections.en: His precious life to death
corrections.reason: Кайран жанды өлүмгө names his life as the object sent toward death.

corrections.en: He simply bound and cast away.
corrections.reason: Жөн эле байлап таштады continues the preceding object.

corrections.en: Tooqyzyl, the horse beneath him,
corrections.reason: Тоокызыл is the named horse, not a chicken.

corrections.old: The back is high, the head is sad,
corrections.en: High-backed, with a low rump,
corrections.reason: Аркасы and соору are the horse’s back and rump.

corrections.old: Don't get tired if you put it forward.
corrections.en: Would not tire when driven ahead.
corrections.reason: Алдыга салса чарчабас praises the horse’s stamina.

corrections.en: Broad of chest and low of mane,
corrections.reason: Кең көкүрөк and тайкы жал describe the horse.

corrections.en: The handsome swift steed,
corrections.reason: Буудан is an epic epithet for a fast horse.

corrections.old: May it be a black cheek,
corrections.en: His black-jawed warrior’s whip
corrections.reason: Булдурсун is a hero’s heavy whip.

corrections.en: He grasped and swung around,
corrections.reason: Кармай калып имерип describes taking hold and swinging the whip.

corrections.en: Without halting Tooqyzyl,
corrections.reason: Тоокызыл is a proper horse name; токтотпой means without halting.

corrections.en: He struck it at the kneecap.
corrections.reason: Томук is kneecap; the parallel 1960 edition repeats the whip action.

corrections.en: Then Tooqyzyl
corrections.reason: Consistent rendering of the horse’s name.

corrections.en: Its thighs spread like a sheep’s,
corrections.reason: Койдой саны бөлүнүп describes the horse’s thighs, not an unnamed divided object.

corrections.en: Its back straightened like a hare’s,
corrections.reason: Ко¸ндой represents коёндой, like a hare; жону is its back.

corrections.old: His mouth opened like a saw,
corrections.en: Its mouth opened wide,
corrections.reason: Араандай оозу ачылып means the mouth gaped wide.

corrections.en: Its once-stiff hooves
corrections.reason: Катып кеткен туягы names stiffened hooves.

corrections.en: Spread out as broad as plates,
corrections.reason: Табактай болуп жазылып likens spreading to plates.

corrections.en: Showing itself a true swift steed,
corrections.reason: Тулпардыгы билинип reveals its tulpar nature.

corrections.en: Leaping and gathering itself like an arrow,
corrections.reason: Жебедей ыргып түйүлүп is a leap and gathered motion compared to an arrow.

corrections.en: The kestrel-like boar’s muzzle
corrections.reason: Жагалмай is a small falcon, and доңуздун is the genitive of boar; the noun continues into the next line.

corrections.en: He turned without tiring.
corrections.reason: Жадабай describes tireless action, while оозун бурду takes the boar’s muzzle from the preceding line as object.

corrections.old: What's the point of running away?
corrections.en: What use was it when he charged?
corrections.reason: Качырганда in the spear battle is charging, not fleeing.

corrections.old: A disbelieving slave full of anger,
corrections.en: The infidel warrior, brimming with strength,
corrections.reason: Каруусу толуп refers to bodily strength, not anger.

corrections.old: Kan Sarybai is a heroic servant,
corrections.en: Khan Sarybai, that warrior,
corrections.reason: Кан is the khan title; баатыр is warrior.

corrections.old: He broke the ice and took the mountain,
corrections.en: He broke ice and conquered mountains,
corrections.reason: Музду бузуп тоону алган gives two active deeds attributed to Sarybai.

corrections.en: Shattered fortresses and defeated foes.
corrections.reason: Чеп кыйратып жоону алган continues Sarybai’s active deeds and names both forts and foes.

corrections.old: At first they knew the value,
corrections.en: In earlier days his worth was known,
corrections.reason: Башта баркын билишкен refers to others recognizing Sarybai’s worth before.

corrections.old: Flirting with the moon and the universe,
corrections.en: Who had fought against all the world,
corrections.reason: Ай-аалам менен тийишкен means contending with the world.

corrections.old: To the world whose name is heard,
corrections.en: His name heard across the world,
corrections.reason: Аты угулган ааламга says his name was heard widely.

corrections.en: His renown reached far and wide.
corrections.reason: Арбагы чыккан далайга praises his far-reaching heroic prestige, not a departed ghost.

corrections.en: Now God had struck him in earnest.
corrections.reason: Аныктап Кудай урду эми is divine judgment upon Sarybai.

corrections.en: He thrust it out with a roar.
corrections.reason: Күркүрөтө describes the roaring manner of extending the spear.

corrections.en: Aiming for the warrior’s brow,
corrections.reason: Кайран эрдин кашы names an intended target.

corrections.old: If it is far away, it will be fine
corrections.en: If approached from afar on the other side,
corrections.reason: Алыс келсе тетири sets a conditional direction, distant and opposite; it does not mean all will be fine.

corrections.en: Aiming for the seat of his heart,
corrections.reason: Жүрөгүнүн башы names the heart’s vital part.

corrections.en: Aiming for the black eyes of that wolf-like hero,
corrections.reason: Көкжал is a heroic epithet; кара көзү are the black eyes.

corrections.old: It is the land itself that dies.
corrections.en: The very place where he would die,
corrections.reason: Как өлөр жердин өзү refers to the very place of death, not the land dying.

corrections.old: The fall of the hip - that,
corrections.en: At the level of his windpipe,
corrections.reason: Колко is the throat or windpipe, not the hip.

corrections.old: Let the spear strike without moving,
corrections.en: Let the spear strike without wavering;
corrections.reason: Козголбостон means without moving or wavering; the line directs the spear thrust.

corrections.en: Then he will fall.
corrections.reason: Кулап кетээр ушул means this one will fall.

corrections.old: It is the time of death.
corrections.en: The moment of death is here.
corrections.reason: Ажалдын убак тушу names the moment of death.

corrections.old: Even though he is eighty years old,
corrections.en: Even if he had eighty lives,
corrections.reason: Сексен жаны means eighty lives, not eighty years of age.

corrections.old: Even if the blue tick is full,
corrections.en: Even if he swelled like a blue tick,
corrections.reason: Көк кенедей толсо да is a simile: even if he swelled like a blue tick.

corrections.en: That foolish woman,
corrections.reason: Катынды is woman (accusative), not a letter; алжаңдаган describes foolish or crazed behavior.

corrections.old: I will take a walk in the afternoon,
corrections.en: This is my time to turn and spear her,
corrections.reason: Аңтара саяр is a spear thrust that overturns; чагым is my time.

corrections.en: Now my moment has come.
corrections.reason: Азыр келди табым means my moment or opportunity has now come.

corrections.en: The moment for him to soil himself,
corrections.reason: Тезегин берген тушу refers to a moment of giving dung; dream is absent. The idiomatic reading as soiling himself is contextual.

corrections.old: If I straightened up and hit the spear,
corrections.en: If I stretch out and strike true with my spear,
corrections.reason: Керилип найза чын урсам describes a true spear thrust made at full stretch.

corrections.en: That wayward woman's fancy,
corrections.reason: Катындын is of the woman, not of a letter; кыялы тентек is wayward fancy.

corrections.en: Even if he had ninety lives,
corrections.reason: Токсон жаны means ninety lives, not ninety souls.

corrections.en: There is no stopping him now;
corrections.reason: Токтоосу жок means without restraint or stopping.

corrections.en: Unable to restrain himself, Sarybay
corrections.reason: Токтоно албай is unable to restrain himself; Sarybay is the subject.

corrections.old: There is a way, there is strength,
corrections.en: He has cunning, and his venom is strong;
corrections.reason: Айласы is cunning or stratagem; заары күч means potent venom or wrath.

corrections.en: Who has ever escaped death?
corrections.reason: Ажалдан кимдер кутулган is a rhetorical question about escaping death.

corrections.old: A wild dog that sees the field,
corrections.en: A seasoned hound who has seen much,
corrections.reason: Даңгыл means seasoned/skilled; далайды көргөн means having seen much.

corrections.en: Scouting and spying on the foe,
corrections.reason: Жоо чалып describes scouting or spying on the enemy.

corrections.en: He is a servant long accustomed to it.
corrections.reason: Мурунтан көнгөн means accustomed from before, not used as an object.

corrections.en: Without counting those around him,
corrections.reason: Теги айланта санабай says he does not count those around him; roots are absent.

corrections.en: Without looking about him,
corrections.reason: Тегерегин карабай negates looking around.

corrections.en: His very cunning ran wild,
corrections.reason: Деги айланы кутургур describes cunning or stratagem running wild; the subject is not an animal.
